mapper.select: SELECT g.id AS id, g.`name` AS `name`, g.sub_title AS subTitle, SUBSTRING_INDEX(g.spu_urls, ',', 1) AS picUrl FROM goods_spu g INNER JOIN goods_footprint f ON f.spu_id = g.id AND f.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND f.del_flag = '0' AND f.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) WHERE g.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND g.del_flag = '0' AND g.status = '1' GROUP BY g.id ORDER BY COUNT(f.id) DESC, MAX(f.create_time) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
